title: NoAppAccess
wrapsNative: MonarchErrorState (kind Forbidden) with MonarchButton and MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher in its actions, a MonarchText polite live region (androidx.compose.ui.semantics.liveRegion) and MonarchInlineNotice
summary: A recipe, not a component: the screen a workspace member sees when they have no access to the app they opened, with who can fix it, Request access, Back to workspace and Switch workspace.
whenToUse: In place of an app's content when the signed-in person belongs to the workspace but has no grant for this app.
whenNotToUse: When the person is not signed in, show the sign-in screen. When the content does not exist, use the error-page recipe with NotFound. When a single record is off limits inside an app the person can use, use MonarchErrorState with Forbidden and no request.
api: MonarchErrorState(title = "You don’t have access to $app", kind = MonarchErrorStateKind.Forbidden, size = MonarchEmptyStateSize.Lg, message = "Ask an admin of $workspace to give you access to $app.", actions = { … })
MonarchButton(text = if (sent) "Access requested" else "Request access", onClick = …, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary, enabled = !sent, loading = pending)
MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher(workspaces = …, selection = workspace, onSelectionChange = { … }) // @ExperimentalMonarchApi, opted in at the call
MonarchText(text = sentMessage, modifier = Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite })
MonarchInlineNotice(message = "The request didn’t go through. Try again.", tone = MonarchTone.Danger)

options.name: appName
options.description: The app the person cannot open, named in the title and the message.

options.name: workspaceName
options.description: The current workspace, named in the message: "Ask an admin of Acme…"; without it, "Ask a workspace admin…".

options.name: request
options.description: The access request: the button shows progress while pending and "Access requested", disabled, once sent; an open request from the server starts as sent.

options.name: onRequestAccess
options.description: Sends the request; without it there is no Request access button.

options.name: contactAdmin
options.description: A ghost MonarchButton "Contact an admin" that opens a mail intent or the list of admins.

options.name: switchWorkspace
options.description: MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher in the actions, or a ghost button that opens the app's workspace list.

states.name: idle
states.description: The title, the message, Request access (primary), Back to workspace and the workspace switcher.

states.name: pending
states.description: Request access shows the MonarchButton loading state.

states.name: sent
states.description: The button reads "Access requested" and is disabled; "Request sent. You can open Rook Tickets once an admin approves it." is announced.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger MonarchInlineNotice under the actions; Request access can be tapped again.

appearance: MonarchErrorState at the large size: the title, the muted message and the actions centered, on the screen's canvas; the app may pass a lock icon in its icon slot. The status line uses the muted text role and the error the danger notice. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web's NoAppAccess is a component built on ErrorPage (forbidden). On Android it is a recipe, as on iOS: MonarchErrorState with the Forbidden kind and the actions as MonarchButtons, because the state machine is a few lines and the app owns navigation. The web's links (homeHref, contactHref, switchWorkspaceHref, linkAs) are callbacks: components do not navigate. The web's focusOnMount and heading level are TalkBack's job on Android: MonarchErrorState's title is a heading. Monarch bundles no lock glyph; pass one in MonarchErrorState's icon slot.
accessibility: MonarchErrorState's title is a TalkBack heading and the message is read after it.
Request access is read as loading while pending and as disabled once sent.
The status line is an always-present polite live region, so "Request sent…" is announced without moving focus.
The failure is a danger MonarchInlineNotice with its tone in words.
Every action has a 48dp target and the actions wrap at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: The access check stays on the server; the screen only explains it.
If a request is already open, start in the sent state so the person does not request twice.
When the person has access in no app of the workspace, offer only Switch workspace.
After a workspace switch, check access again: the screen may no longer apply.

examples.title: Every action
examples.template:
MonarchErrorState(
    title = "You don’t have access to {{appName|raw}}",
    kind = MonarchErrorStateKind.Forbidden,
    size = MonarchEmptyStateSize.Lg,
    message = "Ask an admin of {{workspaceName|raw}} to give you access to {{appName|raw}}.",
    actions = {
        MonarchButton(text = {{requestAccess}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary)
        MonarchButton(text = {{back}}, onClick = {})
        MonarchButton(text = {{switchWorkspace}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost)
        MonarchLink(text = {{contact}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone)
    },
)
